name: Jirai-kei Menhera Danshi to Icha Love Pien Ichigo Tabetaai
original_name: 地雷系メンヘラ男子とイチャラブぴえんイチゴ食べたぁい
source:
When I woke up in the morning, Menhera was in the room.
Apparently Menhera was invading the room without permission!
The protagonist, who is annoyed by being escorted, but for some reason can't let go.
The main character is swayed by Menhera today as well! !! ??

It is a Menhera BL game with a loose head and crotch as a whole.
Let's love Menhera boys! !!

[Taken from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/3522]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
早上醒来，房间里竟然多了个精神不稳定的男生。

看来，他是擅自闯进来的！

主角虽然被他的纠缠弄得不胜其烦，却不知为何始终无法放手。

今天，主角也依旧被他耍得团团转！！

这是一部整体上脑子不太灵光、下半身也不太检点的Menhera题材BL游戏。

来疼爱这些心理状态不稳定的男生吧！

[摘自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/3522]NovelGame[/url]]
